releaseGate: Exact manufacturer subtype / engines / wing tips / door arrangement and dimensions
Source license, author credit, asset provenance and livery era recorded
Cockpit smoke tint; all passenger/door windows included in switchable illumination
Static and moving-part clearance: stowed / 25 / 50 / 75 / 100 percent
12 repeated gear cycles and interrupted reversals at variable frame rates; deterministic endpoint
Reversers recessed inside correct nacelle; source hierarchy and constraints resolved
Lights positioned per subtype; day/dusk/night review on both sides
Self-contained GLB validation and independent geometry/animation import
Production LOD/texture memory review before dense airport scenes
